name: Rahab
summary: A harlot of Jericho who hid Joshua's spies because she believed the LORD had given Israel the land. She and her family were spared when Jericho fell.

key_moments.title: Hiding the Spies
key_moments.description: Rahab hid Joshua's two spies on her roof and told them the LORD had given Israel the land. She let them down from her window by a cord, and they promised to spare her family if she tied a scarlet line there.

key_moments.title: Saved from Jericho
key_moments.description: When Jericho fell, the spies brought out Rahab and all her family. Joshua spared her because she had hidden his messengers, and she lived on among Israel.
